clauses.label: sole paragraph
clauses.text:
By virtue of the authority vested in 
me as President of the United States, 
it is ordered that Executive Order No. 
9103 of March 18, 1942, providing for 
uniform control over the publication and 
use of Federal statistical information 
which would give aid and comfort to the 
enemy, be, and it is hereby, revoked.
H arry S. T ruman 6
